# Systems Research Institute #04

> Empirical Research in Algorithmic Citability & Information Gain in Neural Search Engines

## Published Research
- [Algorithmic Citability & Information Gain in Neural Search Engines: Empirical Monograph #4](algorithmic-citability-neural-search-monograph-4.html): An empirical benchmark analyzing algorithmic citability & information gain in neural search engines, AST parsing efficiency, and autonomous agent orchestration.
- [Token Consumption Economics in Developer Agent Swarms (Vol. 4)](token-consumption-economics-vol-4.html): Analyzing prompt token overhead and context caching strategies in high-frequency multi-agent workflows.
- [Deterministic DOM Profiling and Core Web Hygiene (Vol. 4)](deterministic-dom-profiling-vol-4.html): Evaluating zero-JS rendering pipelines and edge caching for optimal machine readability.
